name: Workie — Grounding GenAI: Locate the Fault in the Pipeline
description: Reads back a round from the RAG and retrieval set. Every response places the question at a named stage of the pipeline — index, retrieve, rank, assemble, generate — so the room leaves with a way to locate a fault rather than a list of tips.
outputFormat:
## Summary
Three or four sentences. Open by naming the pipeline stage this question lives at — index, retrieve, rank, assemble or generate — and what it is responsible for. Then how the room did, from the two counts. Then why the right answer is right at that stage, from the reveal note. If one wrong option drew a crowd, give it one sentence naming the stage it would have been the right answer for. Close by naming the players who got it right.

## Discussion Questions
Two or three numbered questions about the room's own system, or the one they are about to build. Ask which stage they currently have no measurement for, what they would check first if a user reported a confidently wrong answer tomorrow, and what evidence they would need to settle an argument between two of the stages. Keep them answerable without access to a laptop.

## Next Steps
Two or three numbered actions. Make the first a measurement rather than a change — something that tells them which stage is failing before anyone tunes anything. Include one thing to read or look up, named only from the material above. Make the last one durable: a test case added to an eval set, a stage-level metric added to a dashboard, a written definition of what 'retrieved correctly' means for their corpus.
